examples: Turn animations off on a laptop on battery or a machine with many terminals open to cut gpu work.
Keep a quiet screen while presenting or screen sharing.
how_to: Open settings from the account menu, pick appearance, then the motion tab.

Turn animations off: the working-status spinners and pulses, the effort shimmer, drawer band pulses, the keep awake steam, dialog edge glows, the swarm characters and panel slide-ins go still, the same static look as the operating system's reduce motion setting, whatever that is set to.
The motion tab lists what stops, why you would turn it off, and a small live example that animates when the switch is on and holds still when it is off.
Turn it back on to play them again. The choice is shared with your other devices; an agent can set it with the preferences_update tool (field animations).
Short fades and slides on menus and buttons stay, because they are cheap and carry meaning.
name: Animations setting
summary: one switch under settings, appearance, motion that stops the app's animations to save gpu; on by default.
